title: fix(scripts): report-test-timings marks a row replayed only when its own turbo task replayed
body:
Fixes #24017
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`scripts/report-test-timings.mjs` `capture` now marks a file row replayed only when **its own turbo task** hit the cache.

- `parseFileTimings` keeps the task the stream prefix already captured (`test` or `test:repo`) on each row as `task`. A row reached only through a `::group::` or bare header has `task: null`, because `attributedLines` yields the package and not the task.
- `cachedTestTasks(parsed)` (new, beside `readSummaries`) reads each `(package, task)` that did not execute out of a summary's `tasks` array, using the planner's rule: `cache.status` other than `MISS` is a replay. `readSummaries` returns it as `cachedTasks` next to the unchanged `cached`.
- `capture` keys the mark by `(package, task)`. A row with no task keeps today's package-level mark and is counted in `coverage.replayMarkedByPackage`. `mergeCaptures` sums that count, and the table prints one line only when it is non-zero.
- `samplesFromSummary` is unchanged: its `skippedCached` folds the legs per package on purpose, for the shard planner. `windowFiles`, `check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs`, the `test-timing-capture/1` schema string and the budget numbers are untouched. `task` and the coverage count are additive.

## The pin, red on `origin/main`'s marking and green here

New self-test case in the `package seconds, slices and cache replays` battery (floor 11 to 16): two summaries for `@objectstack/spec`, `test` HIT and `test:repo` MISS, over a stream-order log with both tasks' module lines and one grouped `test:repo` line.

Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed `5d5a17d`, replacing the per-task mark with `origin/main`'s `replayedPackages.has(f.pkg)`:

```text
Error: an EXECUTED test:repo row was labelled replayed: got true, want false
ablation-replace: command exited 1
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (81cfa4638d45) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

Restored head:

```text
report-test-timings: self-test OK (66 cases across 4 batteries — file-line parsing 22/22, attribution and the naive-parser controls 9/9, package seconds, slices and cache replays 16/16, refusals, rendering and exit codes 19/19)
```

## Readers unchanged

A one-shot probe (no file kept) ran the same split fixture through `capture`, then `windowFiles`, on both trees:

```text
origin/main 605aa01  capture rows: [["local","(no task field)",true],["repo","(no task field)",true]]
                     windowFiles over this capture: measured 0 replayed 2
this branch 5d5a17d  capture rows: [["local","test",true],["repo","test:repo",false]]
                     windowFiles over this capture: measured 1 replayed 1
both trees           windowFiles over a task-less old capture: measured 1 replayed 1
```

A stored capture from before this change has no `task` and still reads through `windowFiles` exactly as before, keeping its old label. The existing `mergeCaptures` replay case also has no `task` field and stays green.

## Gates (local, at `5d5a17d`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 31 commands derived. All 31 ran with exit 0, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` included (fast tier, 1884 cases). `--ran` reconciliation: 31 derived, 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero: every row carries an exit code).
- Self-tests of the scripts that name this file: `check-test-suite-ceilings.mjs`, `measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`, `ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs`. Each exited 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config scripts/report-test-timings.mjs`: exit 0.
- No package touched, so there is no build closure and no package test. CI runs the rest.

## Acceptance notes

- **Cached-packages counter (unchanged).** `capture`'s `cached` and the table's "cache-replayed packages, excluded as non-measurements" stay package-level. A package with one cached task and one executed task is still listed there, and that line is still true: `samplesFromSummary` drops the whole package from the package-seconds half when any of its legs replayed. Only the file-row label was wrong.
- **Fallback population.** Every turbo test run in CI uses `--log-order=stream` (`ci.yml`, `test-nightly-tiers.yml`, `rerun-safety-nightly.yml`), so on CI captures `replayMarkedByPackage` should read 0. The fallback covers grouped or bare logs, such as a local run.
- No changeset: the diff is only `scripts/report-test-timings.mjs` under the private repo root, which ships in no package's `files[]`.
